title: Horus Telemetry Altitude Leaderboard
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=horus:telemetry altitude_m=*
| stats sum(altitude_m) as total_value, avg(altitude_m) as avg_value by payload_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks payload values by total and average altitude across Horus telemetry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `altitude_m` values for each Horus telemetry event and review total and average altitude by payload.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total altitude.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which payload shows the biggest altitude numbers in your Horus telemetry data.
